```{=html}
<section class="site-grid faq-content faq-page-content" aria-live="polite">
  <p id="faq-results-count" class="faq-results" hidden></p>

  <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--coral" data-topic="Accounts &amp; Access">
    <div class="faq-topic__heading">
      <div>
        <p>Category</p>
        <h2>Accounts &amp; Access</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <article class="faq-item is-open">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="faq-accounts-0">
            <span>Who can use DREAM Lab Cloud Services?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-accounts-0">
          <p>Anyone with an active UCSB NetID (students, faculty, and staff) can create and use a Coder workspace for coursework, research, and data science projects.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-accounts-1">
            <span>How do I sign in to Coder?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-accounts-1" hidden>
          <p>Visit coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu, click 'UCSB Login', and authenticate using your UCSB Single Sign-On credentials via Google.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-accounts-2">
            <span>How long does a workspace last?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-accounts-2" hidden>
          <p>Workspaces are provided for the duration of the academic quarter. At the end of each quarter, all workspaces are automatically deleted. Be sure to export your code and files before the end of the quarter.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--gold" data-topic="Workspaces &amp; Hardware">
    <div class="faq-topic__heading">
      <div>
        <p>Category</p>
        <h2>Workspaces &amp; Hardware</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-hardware-0">
            <span>What hardware resources does each workspace receive?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-hardware-0" hidden>
          <p>Each workspace runs as an isolated virtual machine configured with 4 vCPUs, 16 GiB of RAM, a 64 GB persistent User Data Disk, and a 15 GB OS Disk.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-hardware-1">
            <span>Why did my workspace stop running?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-hardware-1" hidden>
          <p>Workspaces automatically shut down after four hours of inactivity to conserve shared campus compute resources. You can resume at any time by clicking the 'Start' button on the dashboard.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-hardware-2">
            <span>How many workspaces can I have at once?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-hardware-2" hidden>
          <p>Users may create and use only one active workspace at a time. Multiple active workspaces per user may be deleted without prior notice.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--green" data-topic="Software &amp; Environments">
    <div class="faq-topic__heading">
      <div>
        <p>Category</p>
        <h2>Software &amp; Environments</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-software-0">
            <span>What software is preinstalled in Coder?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-software-0" hidden>
          <p>All workspaces come with Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Docker 29.8, Pixi package manager, R 4.6.1, Git, GitHub CLI (gh), jq, and uv/uvx. You can also enable RStudio Server, JupyterLab, and VS Code during creation.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-software-1">
            <span>Can I install additional packages and tools?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-software-1" hidden>
          <p>Yes. You have full sudo access to install system packages with 'sudo apt install &lt;package&gt;', Python environments with 'uv' or 'pixi', and R packages with 'install.packages()'. Packages in your home directory persist between stops and starts.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-software-2">
            <span>Can I use desktop VS Code instead of the browser?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-software-2" hidden>
          <p>Yes! Enable 'Visual Studio Code (Desktop)' when creating your workspace. Install the Coder extension in local VS Code, log in to coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu, and connect directly.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--aqua" data-topic="Data, Files &amp; Backups">
    <div class="faq-topic__heading">
      <div>
        <p>Category</p>
        <h2>Data, Files &amp; Backups</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-data-0">
            <span>Are my files backed up automatically?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-data-0" hidden>
          <p>No! Coder workspaces are not backed up. Users are responsible for backing up their own work. We recommend pushing your code to GitHub, mounting Google Drive with Rclone, or downloading copies regularly.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-data-1">
            <span>How do I upload and download files?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-data-1" hidden>
          <p>You can use the built-in web File Browser on your workspace dashboard, use Magic Wormhole (run 'uvx magic-wormhole send &lt;file&gt;'), or mount your Google Drive via Rclone.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-data-2">
            <span>Will my files remain after I stop my workspace?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-data-2" hidden>
          <p>Yes. Stopping a workspace releases active compute resources but preserves all files in your home directory (~). However, permanently deleting a workspace destroys all files.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--coral" data-topic="AI Gateway &amp; Agents">
    <div class="faq-topic__heading">
      <div>
        <p>Category</p>
        <h2>AI Gateway &amp; Agents</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-ai-0">
            <span>What is the DREAM Lab AI Gateway?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-ai-0" hidden>
          <p>An experimental service providing OpenAI-compatible API access to Google Gemini models (including gemini-4-argon and gemini-3.8-flash) hosted by campus cloud providers for coding assistants and research.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-ai-1">
            <span>Can I send sensitive research data to the AI Gateway?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-ai-1" hidden>
          <p>No. The DREAM Lab AI Gateway is NOT approved for data classified as P3 or P4 under UC protection levels. Never send restricted or personally identifiable data.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-ai-2">
            <span>How do I use OpenCode with campus models?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-ai-2" hidden>
          <p>OpenCode is preinstalled on your workspace. Run 'opencode', and use '/models' to select campus-hosted models through College IT (CIT) or the DREAM Lab AI Gateway.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="faq-topic faq-topic--gold" data-topic="Support &amp; Troubleshooting">
    <div class="faq-topic__heading">
      <div>
        <p>Category</p>
        <h2>Support &amp; Troubleshooting</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-support-0">
            <span>My workspace won't start or is stuck. What should I do?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-support-0" hidden>
          <p>Wait 2–3 minutes and refresh your browser. If it is still stuck, stop the workspace and click Start again. If problems persist, email dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="faq-item">
        <h3>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-support-1">
            <span>Where can I get one-on-one help?</span>
            <i aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </h3>
        <div class="faq-item__answer" id="faq-support-1" hidden>
          <p>Email dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu, drop by the Library DREAM Lab, or join the UCSB Carpentry Slack for community and staff support.</p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div id="faq-empty-state" class="faq-empty" hidden>
    <h2>No matching questions</h2>
    <p>Try searching for different terms, or contact the team.</p>
    <button id="faq-empty-clear" type="button">Clear search</button>
  </div>
</section>
```
